title: Custom decals
subtitle: Use your AlphaConsole-style decal packs again — without injection. Your files stay where they are.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Pick a pack that ships a colour-zone mask (the "Skin" PNG).
how.step2: Choose which of your decals it replaces — you must own that decal.
how.step3: Equip that decal in game: the pack's shapes take your primary and accent colours.
how.limit: Packs with an image show it in its own colours outside the colour zones (AlphaConsole packs can be converted). Octane only for now.

library.title: Your packs
library.emptyHint: Add the folder that holds your packs below (each pack: <Pack>/<Body>/Template.json).

panel.artNote: The art is shown for reference — in game, the zones are painted with your colours.
panel.hybridNote: The mask's colour zones take your primary and accent colours; everywhere else the image keeps its own colours.
panel.universalNote: The art covers the whole car and follows every body. Colours are the pack's own (the pickers don't apply). You need to own the universal decal it replaces.
panel.equipHint: Equip "{{decal}}" on {{body}} in game to see it.
panel.noMask: This pack has no colour-zone mask (Skin PNG), so it can't be used in paintable mode.
panel.bodyUnsupported: The {{body}} body is not supported yet — Octane only for now.
